messages:
maria: Quick check — we need to lock a design review for the new API auth flow + SDK error-model changes. Pre-read is up: https://docs.google.com/.../pre-read (short summary in the doc). :calendar:

suggested slots: Tue 10:00 PT, Tue 16:00 PT, Thu 09:00 PT. Can folks state preference + any must-have agenda items? cc @sophie @jamal @hana

sophie: Tue 10 is best for me. I can cover Console UX impact.

jamal: I prefer Tue 16. If we do 10 I might be on the call but AFK for first 10m.

hana: Thu 09 works. Need ~10m to show SDK error schema examples.

alex: Tue 10 or Thu 09 both ok. Add a quick test plan checklist item pls.

maria: Thanks. I put a minimal pre-review checklist in the doc. Quick copy here:
```
- read pre-read (5m)
- API surface + auth flow (10m)
- SDK error model (10m)
- Console UX changes & migration notes (10m)
- rollouts + telemetry hooks (5m)
- open Q/A (10m)
```

maria: Also: please add any blocking PR links into the doc under "PRs to review" so we can triage during the session.

jamal: Added PR #4532 — note: still waiting on infra test.

sophie: Added Console mockups and a short list of migration considerations.

hana: Dropped SDK snippets + small sample error payloads. Quick ask: can we reserve the first 5m for scope alignment? some folks haven't seen RFC.

maria: Good call — will do 5m scope alignment up front.

alex: If we end up with mixed availability, can we record and post summary? also request branch protection review from eng-infra.

maria: We'll record and I’ll post tl;dr + action items. tagging eng-infra for branch protection: @jamal can you ping infra in #eng-infra with the PRs after the meeting?

jamal: yep will ping.

maria: OK looks like Tue 10:00 PT has most + Sophie can lead console section. I'll schedule the meeting invite for Tue 10 and set calendar to auto-add pre-read + links. If anyone absolutely can't make, reply here and we'll switch to Tue 16 or Thu 09.

sophie: confirmed for Tue 10.

hana: confirmed Thu 09 as backup but will try for Tue 10.

alex: fine with Tue 10.

deploy-bot: Reminder set — meeting created on calendar for 2017-05-23T10:00:00-07:00 (invite sent to participants).

maria: Thanks all — agenda finalized, will add one-line owners next to each agenda item in the doc. If you have blockers, put them in PR section so we can surface during triage. :thumbsup:
